{"reason": "8 failure rows show demand-forecast-error labeled unknown via two paths: forecast-bias with small bias (0.065-0.081, below 0.1) and market-mismatch with forecast-bias=#f. Lower the bias threshold to 0.05 and add a market-signal-mismatch branch mapping to 'demand-forecast-error; supplier-delay branch stays first to protect accuracy and recovered amount.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
          (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    ((market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
